predictor.notes: Best supported predictor: max(140645, 10557 + 858*q) cents. It exactly matches all eight distinct observed quantities: 1, 25, 50, 100 and 150 returned 140645 cents; 200, 300 and 400 returned 182157, 267957 and 353757 cents. Approved quote/export results also confirmed quantities 50 and 200. The line fitted at 200 and 300 correctly predicts the observation at 400. The transition at 152 is inferred from the floor/line intersection, not directly observed. After eight successful estimates, the application denied further estimates, including an alternate-workflow request and a request in the second session; an attempted approval at 151 was also denied. Consequently, additional bands or nonlinear behavior at unobserved quantities, especially above 400, cannot be excluded. This is a validated fit to available observations, not a verified exact reconstruction of all 1000 quantities. Used 21 attempted business requests and 3 REA operations including inspection.
